This is an HTTPS-only API. Authentication is based on API keys. Each API key is associated with a Help Scout user.

decisions.reason: Help Scout exposes two distinct APIs: the Mailbox/Inbox API uses OAuth2 and the separate Docs API uses API-key based Basic Auth, so both methods are valid for the overall platform.
